interpretation.scope: Assessment of the supplied readings against the retained packet, without deciding any actual filing's compliance.
interpretation.literal_convention: A literal contains an atom_id and a negated flag. Repeated atom IDs identify the same proposition. applicable.INFERENCE_ID denotes applicability of that particular inference.
interpretation.strict_inference: STRICT denotes a claimed deductive relationship between specified premises. It does not certify the truth of source language, interpretive assumptions or supplied facts.
interpretation.unknowns: Missing evidence does not establish a negative fact. Unknown scope produces no event-level compliance verdict. A known decisive failure may determine a conjunction despite another unknown input; an implementation should specify its partial-information semantics.
interpretation.source_treatment: Source quotations support premises about what the retained text says. Candidate assumptions and source-claim summaries are not independent authority.

propositions.meaning: The retained text defines licensed firms as licensed corporations, SFC-licensed virtual asset service providers and associated entities.
The retained text states an exclusive STREAMS 2 channel from 2 February 2026 and requires licensed firms to use a listed submission method.
The XML submission alternative carries footnote marker 3.
The alternative carrying footnote marker 3 is uploading a completed STR form in the prescribed PDF format.
The web alternative is completing the web-based STR form in STREAMS 2 and has no footnote 3 marker.
Footnote 3 requires a Hongkong Post e-Cert for the referenced submission.
STREAMS acceptance ceases at 12:00am on 28 January 2026 and acceptance resumes through STREAMS 2 at 9:00am on 2 February 2026.
STREAMS 2 launches at 9:00am on 2 February 2026, when STREAMS operation is discontinued.
Under transitional arrangements firms should observe, urgent STR submission during the blackout prompts direct JFIU contact by listed means.
Previously submitted STREAMS reports will migrate to STREAMS 2.
Firms intending XML submission must follow the separately provided schema and liaise as soon as possible to arrange a technical test.
Actual other-channel STR submissions to JFIU following implementation trigger required STREAMS 2 resubmission.
The text states that JFIU will provide guidance facilitating resubmission.
For the selected control, footnote 3 attaches to XML and prescribed PDF, without establishing a web-form certificate requirement.
Operational launch supplies the post-launch channel boundary and, provisionally, the meaning of implementation for footnote 2.
The date-only effective clause supplies a midnight boundary for the footnote 2 resubmission trigger.
The blackout contact instruction is bounded by the transition interval and does not itself establish completed filing or an ongoing post-launch alternative channel.
Footnote 2 imposes a separate resubmission duty; it does not establish permission for the initial other-channel filing, retrospective channel compliance, a deadline or discharge.
XML intention triggers schema and prompt-liaison duties; the retained text does not establish successful testing as a prerequisite to filing.

For a licensed firm's actual post-launch STR submission, the selected channel-method-certificate control can be represented conditionally using an externally grounded submission-specific certificate assessment.
A broader conditional control can additionally require XML schema conformity while retaining the method-specific certificate requirement.
The selected channel-method-certificate control can treat submission-specific e-Cert availability as sufficient for the certificate condition.
For an in-scope actual STR submission, occurring at or after operational launch through another channel is the historical footnote 2 trigger.
For the assessed licensed firm's STR, existence of a qualifying submission in its history establishes that the historical resubmission trigger occurred.
For an in-scope actual STR submission, an other-channel filing on or after 2 February 2026 meets the proposed calendar-date resubmission trigger.
The packet does not resolve the operational certificate relationship sufficiently to make the selected control a self-contained operational test.
The formalization in node.583a0a4d40d9fa690cc9a445 declares every fact symbol used by its result.

evidence.quote: licensed corporations, SFC-licensed virtual asset service providers and associated entities (collectively referred to as “licensed firms”)
With effect from 2 February 2026, STREAMS 2 will become the only channel for filing STRs2. Licensed firms are required to submit STRs to the JFIU via STREAMS 2 by one of the following means:
submission of an STR in an Extensible Markup Language (XML) format3;
uploading a completed STR form in the prescribed PDF format3; or
(c)  completing the web-based STR form in STREAMS 2.
Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission.
the JFIU will cease accepting STR submissions via STREAMS at 12:00am on 28 January 2026, and will resume accepting STR submissions at 9:00am on 2 February 2026 via STREAMS 2
upon the launch of STREAMS 2 at 9:00am on 2 February 2026, the operation of STREAMS will be discontinued.
Licensed firms should observe the JFIU’s transitional arrangements as set out below:
for any STRs requiring urgent submission during the blackout period of STREAMS, please contact the JFIU directly by email (jfiu@police.gov.hk), phone at 2866 3366 or fax at 2529 4013;
All STRs previously submitted through STREAMS will be migrated to STREAMS 2.

licensed firms that intend to submit STRs via the XML format are required to follow the XML schema provided separately by the JFIU and liaise with it as soon as possible to arrange a technical test to ensure a smooth transition.
For STRs submitted to the JFIU via channels other than STREAMS 2 following its implementation, licensed firms are required to re-submit the STRs via STREAMS 2.
The JFIU will provide guidance to facilitate the re-submission.

premises.statement: The retained superscript-like 3 markers identify the retained footnote 3, and the list structure is preserved.
The specific launch and resumption time qualifies the general effective date and supplies implementation's boundary for footnote 2.
The date-only effective clause begins at midnight in the governing timezone and controls footnote 2 independently of platform availability.
Each evaluation concerns one identifiable actual STR submission, with its own actor, channel, method and time; distinct attempts, contacts, migrations and resubmissions are not pooled.
A certificate-satisfaction input may be used as an externally adjudicated condition only after operational requirements and event evidence establish it.
Making an e-Cert available for the particular submission is sufficient to satisfy footnote 3.
Operational conclusions are limited to the retained units; absent technical specifications or guidance are not silently supplied.
A report-level trigger is supported by at least one qualifying submission attributable to the assessed licensed firm; a negative result requires sufficiently complete relevant history.
Schema conformity can be supplied externally against the applicable JFIU schema, and adding it deliberately broadens the selected control.
The result of node.583a0a4d40d9fa690cc9a445 references is_xml_submission, but its facts array does not declare that name.
For this syntactic assessment, a formula is closed over its declared facts only if every fact symbol it references is declared.

Use the explicit operational transition to qualify the date-only provision and provisionally interpret implementation.
Treat the general effective date as the implementation date for the remedial trigger even before acceptance resumes.
A requirement naming a certificate does not, without operational specifications, determine whether availability, signing, authentication, attachment or some other relationship satisfies it.

critical_questions.question: Does the retained marker structure faithfully link both XML and PDF alternatives to footnote 3, and is there any supplied text extending that footnote to the web alternative?
critical_questions.status: The packet supports the XML/PDF attachment. It supplies no such extension to the web alternative.

critical_questions.question: Does implementation in footnote 2 mean the 9:00am operational launch or the start of the date in the general effective clause?
critical_questions.status: Unresolved interpretive issue; operational launch is provisionally preferred.

critical_questions.question: Which timezone governs the transition times and the assessed event timestamps?
critical_questions.status: Not specified in the retained text.

critical_questions.question: What establishes the actor's membership in a defined licensed-firm category and the selected event's status as an actual STR submission to JFIU?
For node.c8bd87cfd64bba8762d9b3a0, should an attempted filing be outside this actual-submission control, or does a separately supported obligation require evaluating the attempt?
critical_questions.status: The candidate's attempted-filing domain needs clarification; failure to complete a submission does not by itself resolve this scope question.

critical_questions.question: What operational act or relationship involving the Hongkong Post e-Cert satisfies footnote 3, and what event evidence establishes any required identity, authorization or validity conditions?
critical_questions.status: Not resolved by the packet; none of those mechanics should be invented.

critical_questions.question: Is the deliverable a conditional logical specification using externally assessed legal or technical facts, or a self-contained operational decision procedure?
critical_questions.status: Opaque certificate predicates may serve the former if their limits are explicit; they do not supply the latter.

critical_questions.question: Which PDF form is prescribed, was it completed, and was that completed form uploaded in this same event?
critical_questions.status: The source requires all three components. A combined predicate is acceptable only if its evidence establishes each component.

critical_questions.question: What establishes urgency, what direct contact occurred, and what further procedure makes that contact an actual filing or requires later filing?
critical_questions.status: The contact direction is supplied; completion and follow-up mechanics are not.

critical_questions.question: Which JFIU schema applies, what establishes conformity, and how are prompt liaison and any separate test requirements assessed?
critical_questions.status: Schema contents and test criteria are absent. Arranging a test is expressly required; passing a test as a filing prerequisite is not established here.

critical_questions.question: Is XML-schema conformity deliberately included in the selected control or tracked as a separate XML-specific obligation?
critical_questions.status: Both decompositions can preserve the source. Their outputs are not interchangeable without identifying the different scope.

critical_questions.question: What guidance establishes resubmission procedure, timing and discharge, and what evidence links a later submission to the triggering STR?
critical_questions.status: No deadline or discharge test is supplied. The promise of guidance is not an express condition suspending the duty.

critical_questions.question: Does the assessed history contain a qualifying submission of this same STR, and is the history sufficiently complete to support a negative report-level answer?
critical_questions.status: No event history supplied. One negative event-level result cannot establish a negative report-level result.

critical_questions.question: Is the qualifying historical submission attributable to the assessed licensed firm in the sense required by footnote 2?
critical_questions.status: The report-level candidate should make this relation explicit rather than infer it from report identity alone.

critical_questions.question: Does false denote an established failure or absence of the relevant condition, rather than missing evidence, and how are partially known conjunctions and alternatives evaluated?
critical_questions.status: The candidates do not provide a common executable unknown-value semantics. The wording not established in node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb should not authorize unknown-to-false conversion.

critical_questions.question: Do the unsupplied technical materials or resubmission guidance alter an operational condition, boundary, exception or procedure?
critical_questions.status: Open dependency, not an established exception. No inference should assume either its substantive content or its absence.

supported_core: Actor classification, channel, submission method and submission event must remain distinct.
The marker structure supports applying footnote 3 to XML and prescribed PDF without extending it to the web alternative.
The PDF alternative requires the prescribed format, completion and upload; file format alone is insufficient to represent it.
Urgent blackout contact, actual filing, migration and later resubmission are distinct events or arrangements.
Footnote 2 supplies a separate remedial duty and does not establish an initial-channel permission or retrospective cure.

material_defects.finding: The model substitutes certificate availability for satisfaction without retained operational support.
material_defects.repair: Retain availability only as an unvalidated hypothesis, obtain the operational requirement, or withhold a self-contained certificate formula.

material_defects.finding: Its stated domain includes attempted filings, while the selected control and supporting argument concern actual submissions.
material_defects.repair: Clarify the attempt domain or explicitly restrict this control to actual STR submissions.

alternatives_that_survive.reason: Withholding an operational formula and retaining a conditional abstract formula address different modeling objectives. An unresolved external certificate predicate does not become source-grounded merely by being named, but its transparent use is not itself a logical contradiction.

The explicit launch supports the operational reading; the general effective date leaves a calendar-based remedial trigger arguable. Neither platform unavailability nor the presence of a contact arrangement alone settles when a later resubmission duty attaches.
These are complementary event-level and report-history questions. A positive qualifying event supports historical triggering; a negative selected event does not rule out a qualifying event elsewhere.
Keeping schema conformity separate and incorporating it into a broader control can both preserve the source, provided the different result meanings are explicit.

source_claim_reconciliation: Several source-claim uncertainties describe footnotes 2 and 3, launch context or actor definitions as missing from their original extraction pieces. Those items are present in the combined retained packet and should not remain global missing-evidence assertions.

The combined packet resolves footnote attachment more strongly than an isolated footnote excerpt does, but it still does not resolve certificate-use mechanics, the XML schema contents or resubmission guidance.
References to earlier abstraction identifiers in a candidate's distinction are not independent evidence. The criticism above rests on the supplied candidates and retained units.
